K8sCluster.description:
Managed K8s cluster — tenant K8s installed and managed as an option on top of
a BMaaS provisioning. The 3 CP nodes are allocated from the CPU node pool via
NICo (DPU isolation) and bound to the GPU workers over the Converged Network (VNI).
DCGM telemetry is collected via the in-band (DCGM exporter DaemonSet) path.
K8sCluster.title: K8sCluster

K8sKubeconfig.description: kubeconfig issuance history — manages mock PKI (serial), TTL, and revocation.
K8sKubeconfig.title: K8sKubeconfig

K8sUpgrade.description: Cluster upgrade saga — per node cordon→drain→upgrade→uncordon.
K8sUpgrade.title: K8sUpgrade

NicoSegment.description:
Tenant VPC — L3 VXLAN/EVPN isolation domain (enforced by the DPU HBN).

Real-NICo (infra-controller) counterpart: the VPC virtualizer is FNN (L3 EVPN, new) or
ETV (legacy Ethernet Virtualizer) — VpcVirtualizationType in
crates/agent/src/nvue.rs. Dataplane VRF naming is `vpc_<vni>`
(templates/tests/full_nvue_startup_fnn_l3.yaml.expected).
NicoSegment.title: NicoSegment

get.description:
Per-site (AIFactory) **independent** IB fabric — no cross-connect between Gasan and Ansan.

Compute fabric per NCP RD (RD-12835-001-01 v02):
  - dual-network Fabric-A/B (separate subnets → 2 sets of UFM(HA)),
  - 4 rails × 16 leaves/SU per network, 2,304×800G node-leaf links per SU,
  - 2-tier ≤9 SU / 3-tier 10~32 SU (converged is 2-tier ≤4 SU).
Each site has its own spine set, and a tenant cluster is composed within a
single site only (guaranteed by M4 placement).

get.description:
Cross-layer data consistency check — comparing tenant sets.

Compares NOCP (tenants holding orders/allocations) vs the NICo Emulator bridge (segment
tenant_ref) vs the AI Infra physical twin (DPU-attachment tenants), and reports orphans
(orphan — exist only in the physical layer) and missing entries (missing — exist only in NOCP).
Consumed by the 'data consistency' panel of the /flow verification console.

Per-module real-time API call counts, EPS, recent activity + key status totals.

Derives cumulative calls, calls-per-second (60s sliding), and last activity (seconds) for the
14 Control-Plane modules (cp-* + d-*) from the middleware counters, and supplements purely
internal modules with pipeline traces. totals aggregates the number of in-flight orders, jobs,
tenants, and pipeline events from the lifecycle/tenancy store.

Live NICo Emulator integration status (server-side probe, no CORS).

Since the split, the physical twin (/emulator/v1/twin) is owned by :9100 — the NICo-side
values are aggregated from healthz (version, AI Infra reachability, scale) and the site
controller orchestration (/emulator/v1/sites: managed hosts, jobs, tenants_served).
The diagram boxes / right-hand cards show these values verbatim, so this is the sync source of truth.
System connectivity graph for the verification console diagram.

Per-site resource·availability aggregation — generalized to multi-site (N).

Since IB/NVLink do not span sites, a cluster cannot cross sites, so sellable
(available) capacity·allocation·unhealthy state are managed separately per
site. It iterates over factories, so it keeps working as sites grow.
